_about: Skill costs (S) for the stat budget v3, 2026-10-18 (owner 19:54: "Triggers and actions are costed by How often x How strong"). Read by tools/skill_costs.js (tools/card_balance.js) and the master hub (Skill costs tab). A keyword skill costs its value (scale fixed), value × its number (scale n; a true payment counts payDefault), or value × (1 + floor(N/2)) for N > 1 (scale half, the old default rule). A trigger entry {on, do} costs trigger weight × action value; the action value is value × its per field (amount / amount2 / count; a missing field counts 1, or 0 when the other one is set), × min(8, targets), × subAll for sub All. Edits from the hub: tools/hub/pull_skill_costs.md. ENG35 (2026-11-07): one skill per idea (canonical/skill-params.json). A card holds a family as one key ({"v": 2, "hp": 1}); the prices read it as the flat keys below, so an entry marked paramOf (family.parameter) is that parameter's price, unchanged.

budget.formula: BF6 (2026-10-21, owner 15:09: "all coefficients in calculating our caps are halved. So Base=10+Rarity*1+3*Wait... (I kept rarity at *1 not *0.5) and N=(Base + Level/15)x(1+Level/30). Base at lvl 0 is still Base(0) - 1."; replaces BF5's scale 0.5 on the whole N): N = (Base + L/levelLinDiv) x (1 + L/levelDiv) for L >= 1, Base - zeroPenalty at Level 0; Base = base + perRarity x Rarity + perWait x W + perWait2 x W^2 + perLumber x Lumber + perLumber2 x Lumber^2 + perRitual x Ritual points + perMap x the map where the card becomes obtainable (canonical/card-obtain-maps.json); scale 1 (kept as a parameter); then x the card's N multiplier (no abilities plainBonus, only light ones lightBonus). The caps (BF7, 2026-10-22): f x ((2A + H) x m + S) <= N and f x (A*H x m + S*|S|) <= (N/3)^2, m = missMult per half-miss skill (halfMiss) on the stat terms only, f = fragileUse for a Fragile card (else 1); fragileUse replaces BF5's fragileMult (N x 0.75). perLevel is v3 (N = Base + perLevel x L), kept for comparisons. BUDGET2 (2026-10-31, owner RECOST1-6): cap 1 is f x ((attackWeight A + H) x m + S) <= N with attackWeight 3 (was 2A + H); N x scale 1.13 (fitted to keep the in-play cards' median use); cap2Mult 1.57 (2 / 1.13^2, the cap-2 limit unchanged)
